zone.name: Mare Tranquillitatis & Equatorial Maria
zone.why: Team decision of 2026-11-15 (morning): the equatorial maria as analog_finder defines them (absolute latitude <= 30 degrees and elevation <= -1,200 m), applied to the real lunar table.

variables.label: Sunlight without atmosphere
variables.tolerance_set_by: the team lead's delegate on the team lead's behalf, 2026-11-15 (morning)
variables.why: Set by the delegate on 2026-11-15 (from half the robust Earth scale of ground irradiance, 1.22 kWh/m2/day; docs/ANALOG_PRINCIPLE.md section C).

variables.label: Slope
variables.tolerance_set_by: illustrative team values: tierra luna/rover_preset.py version 3, tolerances_by_baseline '5km' (lines 196-205; marked 'ILUSTRATIVO - set by Robotics 1' there); adopted by the team decision of 2026-11-15 (morning)
variables.why: 5 km baseline of rover_preset.py: our slopes have a 3.7-3.8 km baseline, closer to 5 km than to 300 m on a log scale (docs/ANALOG_PRINCIPLE.md section C).

variables.label: Roughness
variables.tolerance_set_by: illustrative team values: tierra luna/rover_preset.py version 3, tolerances_by_baseline '5km' (lines 196-205; marked 'ILUSTRATIVO - set by Robotics 1' there); adopted by the team decision of 2026-11-15 (morning)
variables.why: 5 km baseline of rover_preset.py (roughness at a ~1.9 km lag on both bodies).

sim.weights_why: Key variable 80 % (team decision of 2026-11-15, morning): sunlight without atmosphere 80 %, slope 10 %, roughness 10 %, with the rover's tolerances for slope and roughness.

ice.why: The team lead (2026-11-15 11:28/11:36 CET): glacial ice is not an analog of regolith. snow_ice_frac = ESA CCI land-cover class 220 (permanent snow and ice) share of the cell's land pixels (real_data/provenance_earth.csv).

water.why: Same reasoning as the ice rule (a cell that is mostly sea or lake is not solid ground); mask_fraction = land share of the cell (ESA CCI land cover, inland water counts as water). Found by the first implementer: the Rover number 1, E3872 on the Kara Sea coast, is 33.8 % land. Separately switchable, TO BE CONFIRMED by the team lead.
